An entity sells goods for N10,000 with an agreement to repurchase them in 12 months for N11,000. Under the principle of substance over form, how should this transaction be recorded at inception?
options: Sale of goods for N10,000 with profit recognized immediately
Secured loan of N10,000 received with a liability recorded in payables
Deferred income of N1,000 and sales revenue of N10,000
Operating lease with lease rental income of N1,000
quizzes.correct_answer: Secured loan of N10,000 received with a liability recorded in payables

quizzes.question: Company X is in severe financial distress and management decides to liquidate the business within two months. How should its assets be classified and measured in the financial statements?
options: Non-current assets at historical cost less accumulated depreciation
Current assets at fair value less cost of long-term disposal
All assets classified as current and valued at recoverable amount on sale
Non-current assets at value in use and current assets at historical cost
quizzes.correct_answer: All assets classified as current and valued at recoverable amount on sale

quizzes.question: Under the IASB Conceptual Framework, which qualitative characteristic is directly affected by materiality, and what type of characteristic is it?
In Nigeria, according to the legal framework for financial reporting, what is a mandatory publication requirement for limited liability companies' annual financial statements?
options: Published on the company website and sent to shareholders via email
Published in at least 2 national dailies and signed by a director registered with FRC of Nigeria
Filed exclusively with the International Accounting Standards Board
Published in the Government Official Gazette within 12 months of year-end
quizzes.correct_answer: Published in at least 2 national dailies and signed by a director registered with FRC of Nigeria

options: Contingent liability disclosed only in notes

quizzes.question: Under the IASB Conceptual Framework, which set of attributes correctly describes a perfectly faithful representation?
options: Complete, Neutral, and Free from error
quizzes.correct_answer: Complete, Neutral, and Free from error

quizzes.question: Joe Co buys 100 T-shirts for N3.50 each in cash. During the month, 30 T-shirts are sold for N7.00 each in cash. What is the profit for the month under the Accrual Basis versus the Cash Basis?
options: Accrual: N105 profit; Cash: N140 loss
Accrual: N210 profit; Cash: N350 loss
Accrual: N105 profit; Cash: N210 profit
Accrual: N350 profit; Cash: N105 loss
quizzes.correct_answer: Accrual: N105 profit; Cash: N140 loss

quizzes.question: Which user group of financial statements requires information specifically to assess the entity's ability to pay dividends and manage risk and return on investment?
According to the IASB Conceptual Framework, when does derecognition of a liability normally occur?
options: When the entity loses control of the economic resource
When the entity no longer has a present obligation for all or part of the recognized liability
When the fair value of the liability becomes zero
When the lender requests a conversion into share capital
quizzes.correct_answer: When the entity no longer has a present obligation for all or part of the recognized liability

quizzes.question: What is required under the 'statutory true and fair override' when complying with company law accounting rules fails to produce a true and fair view?
options: The company must revalue all non-current assets to fair value
The rules must be departed from, and details, reasons, and financial effects must be disclosed
The company must switch from IFRS to Cash Basis accounting
The financial statements must be withheld from public release
quizzes.correct_answer: The rules must be departed from, and details, reasons, and financial effects must be disclosed

quizzes.question: Under financial capital maintenance measured in constant purchasing power, how is profit earned during a period determined?
options: When physical productive capability at the end of the period exceeds opening physical capability
When ending equity exceeds opening equity uprated by a general price index
When gross cash inflows exceed total operating expenses
When total assets equal total liabilities plus issued share capital
quizzes.correct_answer: When ending equity exceeds opening equity uprated by a general price index

quizzes.question: Which of the following is categorized as an 'Enhancing Qualitative Characteristic' under the IASB Conceptual Framework?
How is an asset defined in the IASB Conceptual Framework?
options: A physical item owned legally by the company that generates profit
A present economic resource controlled by the entity as a result of past events
Any future cash flow expected to be received within twelve months
The net residual interest in the entity after deducting all liabilities
quizzes.correct_answer: A present economic resource controlled by the entity as a result of past events
